name: Greater Horned Ghoul
body:
Greater Horned Ghoul
CR 5

This gray-skinned behemoth is nearly 8 feet tall, with arms like tree trunks, enormously distended stomach and a toothy maw cavernous enough to swallow a man whole.

XP 1,600
CE Medium undead
Init +0; Senses darkvision 60 ft, scent.; Perception +12; Aura stench (30 ft., DC 17, 1d10 minutes)

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 10, flat-footed 16 (+6 natural)
hp 66 (7d8+35)
Fort +6, Ref +2, Will +7
Defensive Abilities channel resistance +2; Immune undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +11 (2d6+5 plus grab and filth fever), 2 claws +11 (1d8+5), gore +10 (1d8+5)
Special Attacks extended jaw, feed, filth fever, regurgitate, swallow whole (2d6 bludgeoning damage, AC 13, hp 6)

STATISTICS

Str 21, Dex 11, Con —, Int 2, Wis 14, Cha 18
Base Atk +5; CMB +10 (+14 grapple); CMD 20
Feats Power Attack, Toughness, Weapon Focus (bite, claw)
Skills Perception +12

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Filth Fever (Ex)
Bite—injury; save Fort DC 17; onset 1day; frequency 1/day; effect 1d3 Con and 1d3 Dex damage; cure 2 consecutive saves. The save DC is Charisma-based.
Extended Jaw (Ex)

A greater horned ghoul can stretch its jaw and stomach at great rates, allowing it to swallow whole a creature up to its own size.

Feed (Su)

By spending a full-round action devouring the body of a dead or helpless creature within a size category of itself, a horned ghoul gains 2d8 temporary hit points and a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls for 1 minute. The temporary hit points stack up to 40, but disappear after 1 hour. Each such feeding also provides the horned ghoul with a growth point. When a horned ghoul reaches two growth points, it gains the advanced simple template, although without the increase to intelligence. When a horned ghoul reaches five growth points, it loses all its growth points and transforms into a greater horned ghoul. A greater horned ghoul that reaches five growth points gains an advanced simple template (with no increase to Int), and at 10 points the giant simple template (with an increase to Charisma instead of Constitution).

Regurgitate (Ex)

A greater horned ghoul can expel the contents of its stomach as a ranged touch attack with a range of 20 feet. A target hit by the regurgitation must make two DC 17 Fortitude saves, the first to resist contracting filth fever, and the second to avoid being nauseated for 1 minute. Once a greater horned ghoul uses this ability it can’t use it again until it feeds. The save DCs are Charisma-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Organization solitary, gang (2–4), or pack (1-5 plus up to 30 smaller horned ghouls)
Treasure incidental

This squat, quadruped skeleton resembles an overgrown hedgehog, though the spikes covering its whole body are exclusively sharp, jagged bone.

Horned Ghouls are not entirely dissimilar to standard ghouls. On a base level they look quite similar, although perhaps more rugged and savage. They don’t paralyze, are far less intelligent and don’t carry ghoul fever, and thus are not capable of controlled reproduction. What they lack in these departments, they make up in a wild, monstrous hunger that makes the casual cannibalism of ghouls pale in comparison. A horned ghoul arises when a person infected with ghoul fever dies in a state of extreme starvation, no matter if hunger and thirst take them or the fever itself. A create undead spell can also create a horned ghoul, although a feast of ashes spell must be provided as an additional requirement, even if from a scroll or other medium.

A standard horned ghoul is a hunched, sinewy creature of gray skin, milky eyes and sharp teeth. At this point they are of proportions similar to other ghouls and do not differ much physically. The differences start piling up as the horned ghoul starts to feed, at which point it grows considerably in strength and size.

The name of the creature comes from the fact that as they eat and grow, those curious undead start sprouting horns of various number, shape and size. At first, they grow only on their heads, but greater horned ghouls often sprout horns from their backs, shoulders and arms. While initially almost hairless, the horned ghouls also develop patches of dark, coarse and filthy hair that grow in size with each feeding, in case of greater horned ghouls looking like a grim parody of a lion’s mane, covering most of their head and upper back. Horned ghouls are simple pack creatures, always sticking with others of their kind whenever possible and looking for food. They eat only meat and are ravenous without reason, consuming as much as they can, whenever they can. They prefer humanoid flesh, but will devour animal carcasses too when no other choice presents itself. The larger, better fed horned ghouls act as leaders of the pack, which mainly amounts to choosing the direction in which the group heads next, as enhanced size doesn’t bring any measurable increase in intelligence. A horned ghoul is a ghoul without the paralysis special attack and an Int score equal to 2 (all their skill ranks are in perception). The disease they carry is filth fever instead of the ghoul fever. All horned ghouls also possess the Feed special ability.
